description: Dispatch reusable robot routines across continuously moving isometric rooftops; landing geometry and inherited momentum decide success.
name: Lampwrights Program V2 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Light every blue rooftop lantern using the icon programmer. Watch roof motion and dispatch each leap for its landing state. Level, up, and down set the launch arc; roof height and momentum change the landing distance. A missed landing or lighting an unmarked roof ends the shift. Roofs keep moving during editing and dragging. The visible FROM/TO lift state and controller rule determine subsequent motion; the BASE column identifies each lift centre.
